# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplemental assessment artifacts generated for this report.

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md): High-level and component-level system architecture diagrams.
- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md): External dependency inventory grouped by category.
- [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md): Outbound and inter-service contract inventory with sequence flow.
- [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md): Persistence model, ER view, and data ownership notes.
- [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md): Runtime/build configuration and externalized settings inventory.
- [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md): Core business processing flows and decision logic.
